notes: Card: フィ, 필, и (of фильтр) dominate; output suppresses ' filter' tokens. Probe: 필터 0.62, フィルター 0.45, фильтр 0.30, English filter 0.08, but フィルム (film) also 0.38, so katakana フィ words are avoided in the near misses.
